model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different Llama models, comparing their performance with and without fine-tuning (FT). The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" on a linear scale, spanning from 0.4 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1, although the upper limit is not explicitly marked on the axis it is visible on the plot. Four lines are depicted: Llama-3B (blue, solid line with circles), Llama-3B + FT (green, dashed line with triangles), Llama-1B (light blue, solid line with circles), and Llama-1B + FT (light green, dashed line with triangles). The Llama-3B line starts at approximately 0.55 coverage at 2^0 completions and increases to around 0.95 at 2^8 completions. The Llama-3B + FT line begins at about 0.7 coverage at 2^0 and reaches nearly 1.0 at 2^8. The Llama-1B line starts at roughly 0.4 coverage at 2^0 and rises to approximately 0.9 at 2^8. The Llama-1B + FT line begins at around 0.45 coverage at 2^0 and increases to about 0.95 at 2^8. All lines exhibit an upward trend as the number of completions increases.
